title: Hotel Check-In

lines.en: Good evening. Welcome to the Riverside Hotel.
lines.zh: 晚安，歡迎來到河畔飯店。

lines.en: Hi. I'd like to check in, please.
Of course. Do you have a reservation?
Yes, under Ryan Miller. I'm here for a business trip.
lines.zh: 有，名字是 Ryan Miller。我來出差。

lines.en: Three nights, right? Your room is on the sixth floor.
lines.zh: 住三晚，對嗎？您的房間在六樓。

lines.en: Could I get a quiet room on a higher floor?
lines.zh: 可以給我高一點樓層的安靜房間嗎？

lines.en: Let me see. Yes, one is available on the ninth floor.
lines.zh: 我看一下。有，九樓有一間空房。

lines.en: Perfect. Can I check out late on Friday?
lines.zh: 太好了。星期五可以晚點退房嗎？

lines.en: Sure. I can give you until two o'clock.
Great. Is there a good place for dinner nearby?
lines.zh: 太好了。附近有好吃的晚餐嗎？

lines.en: Try the Italian place across the street. Go early.
lines.zh: 可以試試對面的義大利餐廳，要早點去。

lines.en: They often run out of the popular dishes after eight.
lines.zh: 八點以後熱門菜常常賣完。

lines.en: Just say you're our guest. They'll take care of you.
lines.zh: 跟他們說您是我們的房客，他們會好好招待您。

quiz.q: Why is Ryan in the city?
quiz.why: I'm here for a business trip.

quiz.q: What time can Ryan check out on Friday?
quiz.why: Hannah 說最晚可以到兩點退房。

quiz.q: What kind of room does Ryan want?
options: A quiet room on a higher floor
quiz.why: Ryan 問能不能給他高一點樓層的安靜房間。

words.ex1: Hi. I'd like to check in, please.
words.ex2: Please check in at the front desk when you arrive at the factory.
words.ex2zh: 到工廠時請先到櫃檯報到。
words.hook: check 核對＋in 進去：核對好身分才能進去＝辦理入住、報到
words.pic: a smiling receptionist handing a key card across a hotel counter to a traveler with a red suitcase, no signboard

words.ex1: They often run out of the popular dishes after eight.
words.ex2: We might run out of spare parts before the end of the month.
words.ex2zh: 我們可能在月底前就把備用零件用完了。
words.hook: run 跑＋out 出去：東西全部跑光光＝用完、賣完
words.pic: a chef shrugging and pointing at one completely empty serving tray with only crumbs left

words.ex1: Just say you're our guest. They'll take care of you.
words.ex2: Don't worry, our team will take care of the order.
words.ex2zh: 別擔心，我們的團隊會處理這張訂單。
words.hook: take 拿＋care 關心：把關心拿去給對方＝照顧、處理
words.pic: a friendly waiter serving a guest with a smile

words.ex1: Of course. Do you have a reservation?
words.ex2: I made a reservation for the meeting room at two o'clock.
words.ex2zh: 我預約了兩點的會議室。
words.hook: re（先）＋serve（服務）：事先把服務留下來＝預約、訂位
words.pic: a waiter leading a smiling couple to a special table that has a ribbon on the chairs, saved just for them

words.ex1: Let me see. Yes, one is available on the ninth floor.
words.ex2: Is the quality manager available for a call this afternoon?
words.ex2zh: 品質經理今天下午有空通電話嗎？
words.hook: a＋vail（像 value 價值）＋able（可以）：有價值、可以拿來用＝有空的、可用的
words.pic: a friendly bellboy opening a clean empty hotel room door with a glowing green light above it

part2.q: What time does the training start?
part2.why: 問 What time 要回答時間點。A 是地點，C 是時間長度，都不是答案。

part2.q: Could you book a meeting room for tomorrow?
opts: Sure, what time do you need it?
part2.why: Could you 是請求。A 重複 book 的類似字、B 重複 room 都是陷阱。
part2.zh: 你可以幫忙訂明天的會議室嗎？

part2.q: How long have you worked here?
part2.why: How long 問時間長度。B 是地點（部門），C 用 Yes 回答 How 問句不對。

part2.q: Why don't we have lunch together?
part2.why: Why don't we 是邀請/建議，Sure 是同意。A 重複 lunch 是陷阱，C 是地點。

part2.q: Are you taking the train or the bus to the airport?
part2.why: 選擇問句不能用 Yes/No 回答。B 重複 airport 是陷阱。
part2.zh: 你要搭火車還是公車去機場？

scene: Ryan 出差，晚上抵達飯店，櫃檯人員 Hannah 幫他辦理入住。

grammar.tip: 問自己：主詞是「自己做」還是「被做」？東西（貨物、房間、報告）通常是被做的，用 be 動詞＋過去分詞（p.p.）。

items.q: Breakfast _____ from 6:30 to 10:00 on the first floor.
items.why: 早餐是「被供應」的，不會自己供應，用被動 is served。
items.zh: 早餐在一樓供應，時間是 6:30 到 10:00。

items.q: The hotel staff _____ the rooms every morning.
items.why: 員工是「自己」打掃房間，用主動；staff 在這裡當複數，用 clean。
items.zh: 飯店員工每天早上打掃房間。

items.q: Your key card _____ at the front desk yesterday.
items.why: 房卡是「被留下」的，而且是 yesterday（過去），用過去式被動 was left。
items.zh: 您的房卡昨天被留在櫃檯了。

items.q: The new safety rules will _____ to all workers next week.
items.why: 規定是「被說明」的；will 後面接原形，被動就是 will be＋p.p.：will be explained。
items.zh: 新的安全規定下週會向所有員工說明。

items.q: The meeting room has already _____ for Friday afternoon.
items.why: 會議室是「被預訂」的；has already 是現在完成式，被動是 has been＋p.p.：has been booked。
items.zh: 會議室已經被訂走星期五下午的時段了。

phrases.exzh: 下午三點後可以辦理入住。

phrases.ex: Of course you can join us.

We keep spare parts in the warehouse.
phrases.exzh: 我們把備用零件放在倉庫。
